regimeSub: US-Iran strikes resume, Brent punches through $97; September Fed hike odds solidify post-NFP beat.
themes: US-Iran strikes resume (NYT Sep 6) → Brent surges to $97.13 (+85bp) as OPEC+ holds production steady; Hormuz risk premium returns, undoing June ceasefire gains; inflation overshoot narrative extends
August NFP +162K vs ~100K (Reuters Sep 4) still reverberating → Waller muddies outlook (PBS Sep 4) but Warsh Jackson Hole hawkishness dominates; 10Y stuck at 4.77% as September hike now base case
BOK back-to-back hikes (Aug 26-27) driving KRW strength to 1339 from 1346 → KOSPI surges 3.3% to 7129 as HBM/AI capex bid intact; won outperformance vs DXY 99.18 signals EM decoupling
Gold hits $4468 (+2.1%) on geopolitical reset → real rate of 1.47% (10Y minus CPI) no longer sufficient to cap haven flows; Iran resumption trumps Fed tightening narrative for bullion
